question: 回答图片中的问题。如果是选择题，请提供你认为正确的选项。如果是简答题，请提供你的答案。

steps.description: Locate Option A in the image and read the text statement about K molecule structure symmetry
Analyze the molecular symmetry from step_1 to deduce the number of hydrogen environments
Compare the deduced hydrogen environments with NMR peak count to determine if Option A is incorrect
Locate Option B in the image and read the text statement about the reaction between K and L
Apply atom conservation principles to deduce the identity of L based on the reaction in step_4
Evaluate whether the deduced L identity makes Option B incorrect
Locate Option C in the image and read the text statement about M hydrolysis
Assess whether K can be obtained from the hydrolysis described in step_7 to determine if Option C is wrong

Verify if the stoichiometry ratio matches the reaction to confirm Option D is correct
